note: Ana’s first crossing is unavailable. A clearly pictured signal or barrier establishes why she cannot cross here. Luis indicates an available crossing there. Ana follows the short known route, crosses only where permitted, and continues to the museum. Here/there need an established speaker location. Can/cannot requires observable ability, permission or availability evidence. No traffic-safety inference from a generic street photo.
